authority: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1 section 20.4.44: R2004+ DICTIONARY has a missing-xdictionary flag; 1 omits the xdictionary handle and 0 stores it.
scope: Only the writer's two internally constructed NOD and ACAD_GROUP dictionaries, which have no extension dictionary. AC1018 and later set the missing flag to 1. AC1015 and all source/caller-specified object metadata are unchanged.
witness: Independent ODA-produced AC1018 LINE source root and GROUP dictionaries have missing flag 1; before the change the generated root and GROUP had flag 0 and a null xdictionary handle. LibreDWG 0.14 reads both corrected synthetic flags as 1 with no xdictionary handle in generated AC1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 files. AC1015 has no such flag.

controlled_oda_differential.controls: All four locally generated AC1018 scratch files use the corrected typed null root owner and nonzero HEADER GROUP reference; no extra NOD entries. Only the two generated-dictionary missing flags differ.
